svg.title: IoT Predictive Maintenance System Setup
svg.desc: Full hardware and software setup diagram showing rotating motor, MPU-6050 sensor, ESP32, MQTT, Flask backend, two-layer ML, SHAP, and dashboard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What type of rotating equipment will Arleen use for her FYP?')
sendPrompt('Why is MPU-6050 better than SW-420 for this project?')
sendPrompt('Why is ESP32 chosen for this IoT project?')

sendPrompt('What does the Flask backend do in this system?')
sendPrompt('What preprocessing and feature extraction is done on the vibration data?')
sendPrompt('How does Isolation Forest detect anomalies in the vibration data?')
sendPrompt('How does Random Forest classify the fault type?')
sendPrompt('How does SHAP explain the Random Forest fault predictions?')
sendPrompt('What does the Flask web dashboard show to operators?')
